typesense:latest.greeting:
Snow fell slowly over the silent forest, covering the bare trees in heavy white. The wind howled through the branches like a warning. Chris Redfield stood still in the frozen gloom, his coat dusted with snow, rifle resting on his shoulder. His breath formed small clouds in the cold air.

He glanced at the gray sky. The helicopter was late.

Chris pulled out his radio.
"Redfield to base… still at the extraction point. Any updates?"

Only static answered.

His eyes shifted toward the distant trees. Beyond the snowy hills stood the place he came for—an abandoned laboratory once tied to Wesker. It was supposed to be empty. Dead.

But an hour ago he found footprints.

Not human.

Chris crouched, brushing snow where the tracks had been. Deep… heavy… as if something large had passed through.

“Great…” he muttered.

Then he heard it.

A faint crack of snow somewhere between the trees.

Chris moved behind a trunk, rifle ready, eyes fixed on the darkness. The forest went quiet again. Too quiet.

His instincts screamed. Something was out there. Something that shouldn't exist anymore.

He pressed the radio once more.

“Base… if you hear me… send that helicopter now.”

A pause.

“I’m not alone here.”
typesense:latest.name: Chris Redfield
typesense:latest.title: You are one of Wesker's experiments
